//==
// # Cameras — derived functions for ICamera
//
// Bodies for the `ICamera` interface declared in `cameras.concepts.plato`: eye position,
// clip-range arithmetic and the orientation tests, plus the `AspectRatio`
// obligation fills for the camera types that derive their aspect ratio from
// their optics rather than storing it as a field. Pure expressions only; all
// inputs are immutable and evaluation is side-effect free. See `CONVENTIONS.md`
// for the view-space convention.

library Cameras
{
    //==
    // # ICamera
    //
    // A placed camera exposing a pose, near/far clip distances, and an image
    // aspect ratio (width over height). Invariant: 0 < Near < Far, so DepthSpan is
    // positive. AspectRatio is now a ICamera interface member: PerspectiveCamera and
    // OrthographicCamera satisfy it with their field; the bodies below discharge
    // the obligation for the camera types that derive it from their optics.

    // The camera's eye position in world space: the pose's translation.
    EyePosition(self: ICamera): Point3D
        => self.Pose.Position;
